quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories press release: release 20260901-pdf (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results briefing deck: first-half sales of JPY 14,705 million beat the JPY 13,700 million first-half plan and were a record first-half for sales and profit, driven mainly by advanced-semiconductor demand in Taiwan and China; given strong demand from semiconductor makers the full-year sales plan was raised to JPY 29,500 million from JPY 27,000 million (operating income JPY 7,450 million from JPY 6,000 million). By customer type (company estimates), first-half sales were memory JPY 8,287 million and logic JPY 5,353 million, with second-half plans of JPY 7,850 million and JPY 5,750 million; the company expects both memory and logic to exceed the initial full-year plan, and says High-k materials are running strong versus plan. Second-half outlook: demand for advanced semiconductors centred on AI remains strong; China sales will decline in the second half but are running stronger than initially assumed; domestic sales are hurt because some raw materials (for optical fiber) cannot be procured due to Chinese regulations; the second-half FX assumption was changed to JPY 155 per US$1 (initial plan JPY 150). Second-half actions include optimizing near-term production, preparing to raise mid- to long-term production capacity in view of customer trends, and building a production system for next-generation semiconductor materials at the Minami-Alps site.
